name: Cook Food
desc:
🍳 Welcome to Cook Food! 🍳

Ready to become the ultimate food tycoon? Buy ingredients when the store restocks, toss them into your kitchen, cook up wild and wacky dishes, and sell them for big profits! Flaunt your rarest meals and flex your flavor on friends!

[How To Cook]
• Equip the ingredient you want to cook!
• Click on a cooking station in your kitchen to start cooking!
• Wait for your food to sizzle and simmer!
• Once it’s done, serve it up and collect your rewards!

Your kitchen keeps cooking even while you're offline! ⭐
